headline: Record quarter as sales and profit surge, cash burns
summary_short: Revenue of $21.56B rose 37.7% y/y and non-GAAP EPS of $5.68 rose 58.7%, both above the high end of the company's outlook. Operating cash flow was -$917M as receivables and inventory built.
summary_long: Operating margin widened 53bp y/y to 2.98% (non-GAAP 3.42%), while gross margin slipped 61bp to 6.61%. Working-capital growth drove free cash flow to -$976M; cash fell to $749M from $2.44B at fiscal year-end as revolver borrowings rose. The company returned $139M ($100M buybacks, $38M dividends) and declared a $0.48 quarterly dividend. Q4 outlook: revenue $21.8-22.6B, non-GAAP EPS $5.65-6.15, diluted EPS $4.58-5.08.

drivers.explanation: CEO said Distribution and Hyve both performed above expectations and grew above market, citing enterprise AI adoption moving toward broader production deployments and data center modernization.
Constant-currency revenue growth was 38.4%, so currency was a small headwind this quarter (about $100M).
Gross profit grew slower than revenue, so gross margin fell 61bp y/y; the release does not explain why.
Cash flow statement shows receivables (-$1.99B) and inventories (-$1.42B) absorbed cash, only partly offset by higher payables (+$1.31B).

confidence_notes: Period-label note: shard labels this event FY2026 Q3 (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026), consistent with the release. The resolver's q/q reference period (FY2026 Q1) is not the immediately preceding quarter, so no q/q deltas are shown. Non-GAAP figures exclude amortization, share-based comp, restructuring and investment gains. Diluted EPS uses the two-class method. Q4 guidance is in the release's outlook table; the event shard guidance array was not modified (no sanctioned script for it).
